title.en: Greetings — and how to answer them

objective: Greet anyone at any time of day — and answer back the way Palestinians actually answer. Every greeting has its fixed reply; learn them as pairs and the first ten seconds of every conversation take care of themselves.

grammar.point: Talking to a man vs. a woman
grammar.body: Half these pairs change shape with who you face: حالَك to a man, حالِك to a woman; تِسْلَم / تِسْلَمي; فيك / فيكِ / فيكُم / فيكِن. The book drills the m/f/pl endings inside the greetings themselves — copy the pattern, not a rule.

examples.en: how are you — to a man… to a woman

examples.ar: الله يْبارِك فيك... فيكِ... فيكُم... فيكِن
examples.en: God bless you — m, f, pl m, pl f

reply.ar: أهْلِين \ أهْلِين فيك.. فيكِ.. فيكُم.. فيكِن

drills.title: The answer drill
drills.instructions: Read the greeting, SAY the reply out loud before revealing it. The reply must come without thinking — that is the whole point.

produce: Today, greet three people (in your head is fine): one in the morning, one who is working, one who hands you coffee. Say the pair — greeting and its answer — out loud.
